text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! Today and tomorrow are both 
Marvelous☆ Ah, and you over there are 
Marveeelous too★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!! Marvelous is Marvelous☆! Got it!?

I received an incomprehensible explanation 
from Marvelous Sunday...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world still doesn't have enough 
marvelousness~! How can we make things 
even more marvelous, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
How about going at it head-on with 
everything you've got...?

Maybe just roll with the upbeat Osaka 
energy, or……?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All-out?! All right, vroom-vroom! Revvvv 
it up! Screeeeching into gear!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yippee~! I'm really shifting into 
high gear now~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! I can run so much right now! 
Ahahaha☆ Ahahahahaha~★

I don't quite understand what just 
happened, but I feel like I've regained a 
bit of energy……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why meee?! I ain't even from Kansai! 
Sayin' stuff like that don't help me 
none~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it's between grilled squid and 
takoyaki, I reckon I might like takoyaki 
better, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Talking about it just made me crave 
takoyaki! I'm gonna go grab some right 
now☆ Ahahaha~★

I don't quite understand what just 
happened, but I feel like I've regained a 
bit of energy……
